articles.title: Strategy’s bitcoin sale sparks a $14 million betting chaos on Polymarket
articles.snippet: The 8-K filing by Strategy Monday disclosed sales for the period May 26 to May 31, but the disclosure was issued on June 1. Polymarket's May 31 contract is sitting at 81% Yes and in review, while bettors argue over whether the onchain transactions or the filing date controls.

articles.title: NYDIG suggests $1.3B IBIT sale was whale exiting directional trade
articles.snippet: NYDIG’s Greg Cipolaro says a sale below market price and giving up millions of dollars for immediate execution indicates a large directional holder exited a trade on BlackRock’s IBIT last week.

articles.title: US, UK central bankers offer contrary views on stablecoins
articles.snippet: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller told a conference on Sunday that stablecoins expand the reach of US policy while the Bank of England’s Megan Greene expects their popularity will soon fade.

articles.title: Strategy's Bitcoin Sale Timing Throws $50 Million Polymarket Bet Into Dispute
articles.snippet: Polymarket users are waiting for a resolution on whether Strategy's Bitcoin sale took place before the end of May—with over $50 million bet so far.

articles.title: Florida Candidate Liquidates $800K in Bitcoin to Bankroll Congressional Bid
articles.snippet: A Republican candidate jockeying to represent Florida’s 22nd Congressional District liquidated Bitcoin to help fuel his political bid.
